text_block_list.text:
After a bad dream about losing in the
Japanese
Derby, Уиннинг Тикит begins
to panic and push
herself too hard
в тренировке.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When I confront her about this, she
confesses
that she's scared of running in
the Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We talk more, and I realize that she
wants to win
more than anyone. So I
declare that her powerful
feelings are
her greatest strength.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Encouraged by those words and armed
with
determination, Уиннинг Тикит yells
into the night
sky that she will win the
Japanese Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
